$description: WinUI 3 desktop pointer input-tier overrides (Standard 40px ListViewItemMinHeight, 32px controls, 12/16/20px icons).

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for pointer input.

line-height.$description: Unitless line-height ratios per type role for pointer input.

dimension.$description: Desktop pointer layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for pointer input.

density.$description: Page-level row, padding, gap, and surface spacing metrics.

control.$description: Control internal geometry and switch size tier.

switch.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch 40x20 track, 1px off/0px on stroke, 12px knob scaling to 14px hover and 17x14 pressed (ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:5,6,130,269,312 in winui3/release/2.7.0).

on-border.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch checked stroke thickness 0px (ToggleSwitchOnStrokeThickness=0, ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:5).

knob-hover.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch knob expands to 14px on PointerOver (ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:269).

knob-pressed-width.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch knob stretches to 17px wide on Pressed (ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:312).

knob-pressed-height.$description: WinUI 3 ToggleSwitch knob is 14px tall on Pressed (ToggleSwitch_themeresources.xaml:315).

slider.$description: WinUI 3 Slider: 18px outer thumb with 12px accent inner dot (14px hover, 10px pressed) on 4px track inside 32px band (Slider_themeresources.xaml in winui3/release/2.7.0).

band.$description: WinUI 3 Slider 32px hit band (SliderHorizontalHeight / SliderVerticalWidth=32, Slider_themeresources.xaml:167-168).

thumb-width.$description: WinUI 3 Slider 18px outer thumb width (SliderHorizontalThumbWidth=18, Slider_themeresources.xaml:169).

thumb-height.$description: WinUI 3 Slider 18px outer thumb height (SliderHorizontalThumbHeight=18, Slider_themeresources.xaml:170).

thumb-pressed-width.$description: WinUI 3 Slider 18px outer thumb width stays constant when pressed.

inner-dot.$description: WinUI 3 Slider 12px inner accent circle (SliderInnerThumbWidth/Height=12, Slider_themeresources.xaml:166,173).

inner-dot-hover.$description: WinUI 3 Slider inner circle scales to 14px on PointerOver (Scale=1.167, Slider_themeresources.xaml:221).

inner-dot-pressed.$description: WinUI 3 Slider inner circle scales to 10px on Pressed (Scale=0.71, Slider_themeresources.xaml:233).

radio.$description: WinUI 3 RadioButton: 20px outer circle with ControlAltFillColorSecondary rest interior and 12px inner dot (14px hover, 10px pressed; RadioButton_themeresources.xaml in winui3/release/2.7.0).

dot.$description: WinUI 3 RadioButton 12px inner glyph diameter (RadioButtonCheckGlyphSize=12, RadioButton_themeresources.xaml:179).

dot-hover.$description: WinUI 3 RadioButton 14px inner glyph diameter on PointerOver (RadioButtonCheckGlyphPointerOverSize=14, RadioButton_themeresources.xaml:180).

dot-pressed.$description: WinUI 3 RadioButton 10px inner glyph diameter on Pressed (RadioButton_themeresources.xaml:68-80).

calendar.$description: WinUI 3 CalendarView: 40x40px circular cells (RoundedChromeEnabled=True), filled AccentFillColorDefault today cell, 2px accent-outlined selected cell (CalendarView_themeresources.xaml:62,244-245,767).

outline-width.$description: WinUI 3 CalendarView 2px selected cell ring thickness (CalendarView_themeresources.xaml:767).
